qualification: Git dates and run records describe the claimed workflow ordering, not an independent registry timestamp. The original private project history is not included in the public companion repository. Mixed-clock timestamps are not directly comparable.

clock_sources.analysis_runs: P15 e15_citers_20261127_01/02 started_utc values were generated on the analysis VM (run.json host: vm-project-c), using time.strftime with time.gmtime on that host's system clock.

clock_sources.git_dates: Author and committer dates are client-generated Git timestamps from the local machine, not GitHub server receipt timestamps.
clock_sources.limitation: These records are non-monotonic across clock sources. No recorded synchronization check or measured offset is available, so an exact one-hour correction is not asserted. Original timestamps and run checksums are preserved; cross-host chronology cannot be established from the timestamp strings alone.
